I will tell the prescriber about all weight-loss medicines and will not combine treatments without their specific instructions.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
I understand severe or persistent abdominal pain, vomiting or yellowing of the skin or eyes needs prompt medical assessment, rather than waiting for an online reply.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?

I will contact the clinical team about mood changes or new mental health concerns and seek urgent help if my safety is at risk. The prescriber must provide individual advice about any treatment changes.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
I will follow the medicine-specific missed-dose instructions and contact the clinical team before restarting after two or more missed doses.

I will report side effects, new medicines and changes in my health to the clinical team and keep my GP informed as advised.

I confirm this request is for my own treatment and I will not share prescribed medicine.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
I confirm my answers are complete and accurate, and understand the prescriber uses them to assess suitability.

I understand all treatment requests require a prescriber’s decision; more information may be needed and payment does not guarantee a prescription.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
For this fictional test, I have read the displayed private-workspace information and understand the test answers and files are saved with this request.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
I confirm I am aged 18 to 75 for this draft pathway. This draft service boundary requires clinical approval before real use.
What would you like the clinical team to clarify?
I understand vomiting or severe diarrhoea can affect oral contraception. If tirzepatide is proposed, I need the specific additional contraception advice at treatment initiation and dose increases.
I understand the clinical team must advise me about pregnancy, trying to conceive and breastfeeding before treatment, and I will contact them immediately if my circumstances change.

Please explain any concerns or restrictions about GP contact or information sharing. A clinician must assess whether care can proceed safely.

If a clinician proposes treatment outside its licence, I understand they must explain the specific proposal, benefits, risks and alternatives and obtain appropriate consent before prescribing. This answer is not consent to off-label treatment.
